definition: GOCE orbit counter: orbit numbers and ascending-node crossing times, made from TLEs
description:
The GO_ORBCNT product is a preliminary orbit counter for the GOCE satellite, made from Two-Line Elements (TLEs). It covers the whole GOCE mission, from 2009-03-17 to 2013-11-09, in a single NASA CDF file. Following the Swarm orbit counter convention, an orbit starts at the ascending-node Equator crossing. The file gives a quick overview of altitude and magnetic local time and can be used for conjunction analysis with Swarm and other missions. It goes with the GOCE platform magnetometer data (GO_MAG_ACAL_CORR).

File naming: GO_ORBCNT_<start yyyymmddThhmmss>_<end yyyymmddThhmmss>_<version>.cdf, e.g. GO_ORBCNT_20090317T231001_20131109T234516_0101.cdf.
variables_table:
Variable,Units,Description,Dim,Type
Timestamp,-,Time of the ascending-node Equator crossing (start of the orbit) (UTC),1,CDF_EPOCH
Latitude,deg,Geocentric latitude at the ascending-node crossing,1,CDF_DOUBLE
Longitude,deg,Geocentric longitude at the ascending-node crossing,1,CDF_DOUBLE
Radius,m,Geocentric radius at the ascending-node crossing,1,CDF_DOUBLE
OrbitNo,-,Orbit number (counted from 1 at mission start),1,CDF_DOUBLE
MLT,h,Magnetic local time at the ascending-node crossing,1,CDF_DOUBLE
